verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents delegating infrastructure work to Pulumi Agents/Neo, which it says executes changes and monitors outcomes automatically and can maintain infrastructure. MCP-connected assistants can also hand tasks off to Neo, so some autonomous agent operation is first-party. However, nothing documents setting up recurring, scheduled or triggered automations that run unattended in the background; Automation API is only an SDK building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented scheduling/triggering of background agent runs, details on how autonomous automations are configured and supervised, independent or hands-on corroboration.
